title: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Policy Improvement via Flow-Reversed Action Anchors
abstract: arXiv:2610.22852v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generalist robot policies offer strong behavioral priors, but achieving deployment-level reliability and throughput remains difficult. Reinforcement learning (RL) can improve these policies, yet its effectiveness is constrained by the cost of online interaction. Existing methods adapt frozen flow-matching policies by treating noise space as a continuous action space. We show that this behaviorally unstructured space makes exploration inefficient, often preventing these methods from extracting meaningful learning signals on challenging tasks. We introduce AnchorQ, which enables coarse-to-fine policy improvement through a structured, refinable latent action representation. At each decision step, AnchorQ uses flow reversal to map reference behaviors to state-conditioned latent anchors, samples local particles around those anchors, and applies value-guided sampling to explore promising refinements. translated_title: 基于流反转动作锚点的高样本效率强化学习策略改进
translated_abstract: 通用机器人策略提供了强大的行为先验，但要达到部署级别的可靠性和吞吐量仍然困难。强化学习（RL）可以改进这些策略，但其有效性受到在线交互成本的限制。现有方法通过将噪声空间视为连续动作空间来适配冻结的流匹配策略。我们证明，这种在行为上缺乏结构的空间会导致探索效率低下，往往使这些方法无法在具有挑战性的任务上提取有意义的学习信号。我们提出了AnchorQ，它通过一种结构化、可细化的潜在动作表示实现由粗到细的策略改进。在每个决策步骤中，AnchorQ利用流反转将参考行为映射为状态条件下的潜在锚点，在这些锚点周围采样局部粒子，并应用价值引导采样来探索有前景的细化方向。我们的分析表明，锚点降低了id（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出AnchorQ方法，利用流反转将参考行为映射为结构化的潜在动作锚点，并通过价值引导的由粗到细粒子采样，显著提升了强化学习改进机器人策略时的样本效率。
en_tdlr: AnchorQ achieves sample-efficient reinforcement learning for policy improvement by using flow reversal to map reference behaviors to structured latent action anchors and applying value-guided coarse-to-fine particle sampling.
